name: first-principles
description: Coding discipline as seven independent gates rather than a workflow, over a shared canon of five first principles and a security spine. Each gate produces a verdict with evidence and admits its gaps.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based coding gates for disciplined changes.
interface.longDescription: First Principles provides seven independent gates for coding work: scope, build, cut, done, bug, ship, and watch. They operationalize five principles—verified beats assumed, one state one owner, fix the class not the instance, change exactly what was asked, and reversibility decides who acts—plus a security spine.
defaultPrompt: Apply the scope gate to this change.
Audit this code with the bug gate.
Run the done gate before I call this complete.
